You already do this for free.

Somebody asked who did your photos. Who built your site. Who fixed your follow-up. And you told them.

That's a referral. You just didn't get paid for it.

Here's what changed. Two years ago, sending someone to Signature meant one thing — a photo session. Today it's five.

Which means you don't have to find somebody who needs a photographer anymore. You need somebody whose phone rings and who's losing the people on the other end. You already know that person.

Ambassadors earn 25% of setup and 15% of the monthly — every month that client stays. Not a finder's fee.

You don't sell anything. Make the introduction. We do the rest.
